entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: instructed by V.A. Associates for the Plaintif.
Mr. R.D. Motkari for Defendant No.1.
Mr. S.S. Joshi for Defendant Nos.2 and 3.
Mr. Jeetendra Solanki for Defendant No.4.

Coram : S.J. Kathawalla, J.
Dated : 4th March, 2019 P.C.:

The Learned Advocate appearing for Defendant Nos.2 and 3 states that the uncle of
Defendant Nos.2 and 3 has passed away and therefore, they are not present in Court.
Stand over to 13th March, 2019, when all the Defendants shall remain present in Court.
All the Defendants through their respective Advocates waive service of the writ of summons.
The Defendant No.2 shall produce the original license under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 issued by the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India, on the adjourned date.
